purpose: Improved-planner configuration frozen BEFORE the held-out sets were run for the first time. If the fingerprint in a held-out report differs, the planner changed after the freeze.
design_iterations_on_dev_sets: v0: required-deceleration policy with delay-compensated gap, proportional braking, TTC cannot STOP. dev_random: 0 avoidable collisions but 16% unnecessary braking (hard stops on the first frames of every track).
v1: obstacles whose closing speed is not yet measured are capped at SAFE_A_UNCONFIRMED (found by inspecting the t=0 hard stops).

v2: Kalman closing speed trusted only from SAFE_MIN_TRACK_HITS=5 hits; raw LiDAR-minimum range-rate not used for demand in kalman mode (found by inspecting hard stops on 3-hit tracks whose closing speed was 2x the truth under distance noise).
Constants SAFE_ACTUATOR_LAG, SAFE_MARGIN_FACTOR, SAFE_A_SLOW, SAFE_A_STOP, SAFE_A_IMMEDIATE, SAFE_RELEASE_RATIO were set a priori and not changed during iteration.
